purpose: Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for CYNIC canonical vocabulary. Eliminates jargon drift, homonyms, and palimpsest naming.

DeploymentTier.definition: Lifecycle environment stage for deployment and validation.
DeploymentTier.rationale: An environment tier is not a test harness. A harness is a test execution apparatus, never a target deployment stage.

TestHarness.definition: Execution scaffold and evaluation instrumentation for measuring agents, benchmarks, models, or regression suites.
banned_usages: Using harness to describe production or staging environments

Authority.definition: The legitimate, verifiable constituent or delegated source of decision power.
banned_usages: Arbitrary enum levels masquerading as authority gates without signed receipts

Grant.definition: A bounded, non-transferable, time-leased and workload-specific delegation of authority.

Service.definition: A bounded sovereign system daemon, process, or LXC compute unit with health signals.
banned_usages: Vague synonym for pure Rust domain modules

MonotonicRatchet.definition: A compliance and health assertion enforcing that measured debt never increases (current <= ceiling) while allowing debt reduction without breaking the gate.
MonotonicRatchet.prescribed_usage: All governance checks measuring retired metaphors, god-object size limits, and transitional debt.
banned_usages: Using strict scalar equality (actual == declared) that penalizes debt payoff or unblocks only with synchronous manual contract updates

TopologyGenerator.definition: Pure inference engine that derives the workspace directed acyclic graph (DAG) and canonical extraction order directly from Cargo metadata and layer rules.
TopologyGenerator.prescribed_usage: Always derived via cynic audit topology --apply, never manually authored in infra/crate-topology.json.
banned_usages: Feature-gating the topology generator behind obscure or uncompiled build flags
Hand-editing topological dependency edges or extraction order

PassiveFixture.definition: Non-executable evaluation data, historical traces, session snapshots, or training labels stored for test verification.
banned_usages: Treating captured test traces or eval datasets as active executable workspace path consumers

ArtifactPublicationTransport.definition: Typed network protocol (TransportProtocol enum) governing binary artifact release and node deployment.
banned_usages: Passing raw string literals for publication transport protocols in domain code and tests

NodeRole.definition: Canonical top-level topological role of a node in the CYNIC mesh. Follows the agnostic distributed systems standard with 5 invariant roles: compute, storage, gateway, control, workstation. Specializations are expressed via capability flags, not hardcoded software roles.
banned_usages: Passing software-coupled or metaphor-based role names (cortex_host, mesh_coordinator, forge_primary, storage_primary) as canonical NodeRole values

BuildAction.definition: Canonical lifecycle action for a build workload execution on the builder pool.
banned_usages: Using arbitrary string verbs for build workload actions

BuildRole.definition: Canonical execution role of a node capable of running build workloads.
banned_usages: Using hardcoded node IPs or software-coupled names for build runners

EvidenceKind.definition: Canonical discriminator for captured machine receipts and evidence envelopes.
banned_usages: Substring matching against arbitrary string identifiers to classify evidence

ArtifactTransport.definition: Sovereign protocol and payload abstraction governing binary artifact transfer, staging, and publication.
banned_usages: Maintaining separate, drifted HTTP transport mechanisms for runtime staging versus release publication
